senses.gloss:
योक्तृ m. [युज्-तृच्]
—1 One who yokes, joins, unites &c.
—2 A coachman.
—3 An exciter, instigator.

—1 A cord, rope, thong, halter.
—2 The tie of the yoke of a plough.
—3 The rope by which an animal is tied to the pole of a carriage; छेदने
 चैव यन्त्राणां योक्त्ररश्म्योस्तथैव च Ms. 8. 292.
—4 A churning cord; ततो निश्चित्य मथनं योक्त्रं कृत्वा च वासुकिम्
 Rām. 1. 45. 18, 19.
